verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect paths to getting data out: the subscribers API can filter records by tags, segments and dates, the broadcasts API exposes send history, and the CLI and MCP can search and look up subscribers. A data-deletion endpoint can anonymize visitors, which partly covers leaving cleanly. Nothing documents an actual export feature, and CSV appears only as an import format. missing for 10: a documented full-account export (subscribers, events, templates, workflows, sequences) in open formats such as CSV or JSON, an export or offboarding guide, a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none), and hands-on corroboration of a complete data extraction.
